items.title: Finiteness of H^q of the outer terms of a short exact sequence of Lambda-modules on a separated finite type curve over an algebraically closed field implies finiteness of H^q of the middle term
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts finite-generation of middle cohomology from that of the two ends (statement lines 15996-16004). The proof is the one line (proof lines 16006-16008) that H^q(X, F) sits in the long exact sequence between H^q(X, F_1) and H^q(X, F_2), both finite Lambda-modules, and over the Noetherian ring Lambda an extension of finite modules is finite. H2: a single standard application of the long exact sequence on finite modules.
